description: Normative fact-export-v1 schema for the coverage table. Exports explicit denominators, discovery/read/projection statuses, and field-level fidelity/missingness counts per (source_id, source_generation, canonical_harness, target_table, coverage_dimension). Resolves F14, F1, D5, and A5a without nulls.

accepted_count.description: Count of records accepted and projected into target_table for this (source_id, source_generation, canonical_harness).

x_justification.why_present: Provides the accepted record numerator against encountered_count.

canonical_harness.description: Closed canonical harness vocabulary, including unknown.

x_justification.why_present: Partitions coverage and missingness denominators by harness platform (including 'pi' when connector_unimplemented per F1).

coverage_dimension.description: Specific ingestion or field-level fidelity dimension measured by this row (D5, F14).

x_justification.why_present: Separates row-level ingestion completeness from field-level unknownness such as observed_cost_usd (F14) and git_outcome_evidence (EN6b).

coverage_key.description: SHA256 of the length-prefixed public coverage tuple.

x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Primary key for deterministic coverage row replacement across snapshots.

coverage_status.description: High-level completeness classification derived deterministically from the denominator and numerator counts.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum constrained by x_invariants.
x_justification.why_present: Drives UI coverage badges (A5a) and analytical confidence gating (EN6a, EN6b) without ambiguous nulls.

denominator_basis.description: Unit of the denominator (expected_population_count) for this coverage row.

x_justification.why_present: States the exact denominator unit so downstream consumers can compute unambiguous coverage percentages (e.g. 12/50 accepted_usage_rows with observed_cost_usd).

discovery_status.description: Status of local source discovery for this harness root (retrieval_v1).

x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 5-value enum; never contains filesystem paths.
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes a harness with 0 sessions because the directory is empty vs not installed or unreadable (AGENTS.md §3.6, D5).

encountered_count.description: Total raw records encountered during ingestion for this dimension: accepted_count + rejected_count + recognized_unprojected_count.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-negative integer; must equal accepted_count + rejected_count + recognized_unprojected_count.
x_justification.why_present: Provides the explicit ingestion denominator so dropped or unprojected records are never silently hidden.

expected_population_count.description: Explicit denominator for coverage_dimension in target_table: observable_count + unknown_or_missing_count.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-negative integer; must equal observable_count + unknown_or_missing_count.
x_justification.why_present: Guarantees every coverage metric carries its exact denominator alongside its numerator (MVP plan §2 Decision 3, F14).

field_fidelity.description: Fidelity tier of the observed values in this coverage dimension (D5).

x_justification.why_present: Communicates whether observed values are exact (e.g. harness_observed_exact cost), inferred/partial (e.g. inferred_from_session model or observed_partial git evidence), or unavailable.

gap_reasons.description: Non-empty ordered list of closed-vocabulary reason codes explaining any missingness, rejection, or unavailability in this dimension.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-empty array of closed enum tokens; ['none'] iff coverage_status in ['complete', 'empty'].
x_justification.why_present: Provides machine-actionable explanations for partial or unavailable coverage (F1, F14, D5, A5a).

observable_count.description: Numerator of records in expected_population_count where the target dimension is known/observed.

x_justification.why_present: Explicit numerator of known/observed facts for this dimension.

projection_status.description: Status of fact projection for this harness and table (retrieval_v1, F1).

x_justification.why_present: Resolves F1 (Pi enum exists without a connector) by explicitly reporting 'connector_unimplemented' rather than silent zero rows.

pseudonym_key_id.description: Identifier of the customer-held HMAC key generation used to pseudonymize identifiers in this row (DE-004, F13).

x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks customer-held key rotation across coverage digests.

read_status.description: Status of reading discovered source artifacts (retrieval_v1).

x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes clean artifact reads from truncated JSONL lines or skipped corrupt files.

recognized_unprojected_count.description: Count of valid harness records recognized by the parser that intentionally do not project into target_table (retrieval_v1).

x_justification.why_present: Prevents benign non-fact log lines (e.g. heartbeat/UI events) from inflating rejected_count while still balancing encountered_count.

rejected_count.description: Count of malformed, corrupt, or schema-invalid raw records rejected during extraction.

x_justification.why_present: Surfaces parser/validation loss without leaking raw malformed line content (DE-004).

source_generation.description: Monotonic positive integer generation of the source extraction state.

x_justification.why_present: Aligns coverage denominators with the exact generation of the fact tables in the snapshot.

source_id.description: Pseudonymized 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the logical source root.

x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Associates coverage denominators with the pseudonymized source root.

target_table.description: Fact table whose ingestion or field-level completeness is described by this coverage row.

x_justification.why_present: Binds every coverage denominator to a specific fact-export-v1 table.

unknown_or_missing_count.description: Count of records in expected_population_count where the target dimension is explicitly unknown or missing (e.g. cost_provenance == 'unknown' or agent.session.link_id == null).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-negative integer; must equal expected_population_count - observable_count.
x_justification.why_present: Quantifies explicit unknownness (F14) so downstream analytics never mistake missing values for zero.

title: fact-export-v1 coverage table row
x_invariants: coverage_status == 'complete' <=> (expected_population_count > 0 && observable_count == expected_population_count && unknown_or_missing_count == 0 && rejected_count == 0 && recognized_unprojected_count == 0)
